limitations: Single synthetic diagram style (flat light-gray dark squares, chessnut piece set); does not cover hatched, photographic, scanned, or hand-drawn book diagram styles.

No drawn outer board border: a border (even 0.5pt) pulled fenshot's gradient-peak board detector off by a fraction of a square, shifting the read by whole ranks. Piece scale is 88% of the square. See the generator's style docstring.

The hatched dark-square variant (CHESS_READER_FIXTURE_STYLE=hatched) is NOT recognized reliably by the pinned model: measured 1/48 correct reads across six selection margins and eight capture resolutions, versus 48/48 for this flat-gray fixture. Tracked in https://github.com/nino96/chess-reader/issues/24; see the generator's style docstring for the measurement.
Piece glyphs are redistributed from the chessnut-pieces set (Apache-2.0); see assets/pieces/chessnut/PROVENANCE.md for full attribution.
Diagnostic pair with pdf-synthetic-diagram-01; same position and Apache-2.0 chessnut glyphs. See assets/pieces/chessnut/PROVENANCE.md.
